name: Card Creek (Elk City Lake)
note: Corps of Engineers campground on Card Creek just above where it enters Elk City Lake, 5 miles west of Independence off US-160 (paved to the park). One gravel row along the creek: 15 electric sites (9 with water too) and 4 without; the sites on the creek side of the road (about 8-14) sit on open grass above the bank. Boat ramp; the Elk River Hiking Trail is adjacent. Site 14 closed for maintenance until further notice (recreation.gov notice, read 2026-11-06). --Claude

name: Cottonwood Campground (Entiat River)
note: Okanogan-Wenatchee NF campground 38 miles up the Entiat River Road from US-97A, ~3,100 ft, in a valley recovering from wildfire. 25 first-come, first-served sites along the Entiat River; trailers up to 25 ft recommended, and the road can be rough in spots. Vault toilets and garbage service; no hookups. Trailheads into the Glacier Peak country beyond; Cottonwood Cabin next door is reservable. --Claude

name: Birch Grove Campground (Twin Lakes, Washburn)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF campground between East and West Twin Lakes, 8 miles west of Washburn on the Bayfield Peninsula. 16 single-family sites for tents or RVs, 25-45 ft; both lakes have small boat access. No hookups. Some sites reservable, the rest first-come, first-served. Blueberry picking in the Moquah Barrens in late summer; Valhalla trails and the Long Lake beach nearby. --Claude

name: Putah Canyon Campground (Lake Berryessa)
note: Large concession-run campground on the northwestern shore of Lake Berryessa, on Berryessa Knoxville Road half a mile north of Pope Canyon Road, about 45 minutes from Napa or Winters. Around 160 sites - tent-only, RV-or-tent and RV-only - most of them on the water, many with room to moor a boat below the site; some RV sites have electric for an extra fee. Boat and watercraft rentals. Reservable May 1 to October 1, first-come, first-served otherwise; open year-round. Extra-person, pet and vehicle fees apply. --Claude

name: North Fork Campground (Stony Creek, Mendocino NF)
note: Small Mendocino NF campground in an open oak grove above the North Fork of Stony Creek, about 10 miles west of Stonyford on paved Road 18N03 in the Fouts Springs OHV area. 10 sites, trailers to 30 ft; vault toilet, no drinking water, pack out trash, no hookups. First-come, first-served (scan-and-pay). --Claude

name: Airport Flat Campground (Gerle Creek, Eldorado NF)
note: Eldorado NF campground off Ice House Road (FR 3, then FR 33) near Gerle Creek Reservoir, 5,300 ft. 16 tent/trailer/RV units with tables, fire rings and bear boxes; vault toilet, no water (bring your own), no hookups; dump station at the Loon Lake boat ramp. First-come, first-served, Memorial Day to mid-October. Popular with OHV riders heading for the Rubicon Trail. --Claude

name: Red Mountain Campground (Cle Elum River)
note: Small Okanogan-Wenatchee NF campground between Salmon La Sac Road and the Cle Elum River north of Roslyn, ~2,300 ft. 10 single sites for tents and RVs up to 30 ft; no hookups. First-come, first-served, late May to early October. --Claude

name: Beaver Point (Fort Supply Lake)
note: Low-cost Corps of Engineers campground on the east shore of Fort Supply Lake in northwest Oklahoma, below the dam embankment. 16 open, grassy non-electric sites around a loop, several with shade shelters right by the water; vault toilet, boat ramp, swim beach down the road. No hookups. First-come, first-served (scan-and-pay). Crappie, walleye and catfish; sand dunes line the shore. --Claude

name: Cove Lake State Park Campground
note: Tennessee State Parks, Caryville, just off I-75. Single campground with tent and RV sites, all with water and electric hookups; dump station, two bathhouses, seasonal camp store, 2-week stay limit. CLOSED THROUGH 2026 for a renovation project (park camping page, checked 2026-09-29). --Claude

name: Standing Stone State Park Campground
note: Tennessee State Parks, Hilham, around Standing Stone Lake in the Cumberland foothills. Tent and trailer sites with water and 20/30/50-amp electric, two bathhouses, dump station, WiFi. RVs over 30 ft must enter via Hwy 52 to Hwy 136 (south entrance impassable to RVs). CLOSED for renovations since 2025-07-07, expected into late 2026 (checked 2026-09-29). --Claude

name: Long Branch State Park Campground
note: Missouri State Parks, on a wooded peninsula of Long Branch Lake just west of Macon. Basic, electric (50-amp available), family and 8 walk-in sites in two loops (1-40 & 73-83, 41-72); dump station, firewood vending. CLOSED FOR ALL OF 2026 for construction (park camping page, checked 2026-09-29). Normally reservable 12 months ahead. --Claude
